text: Rods have a {{c1::slow::speed}} recovery time, while cones have a {{c1::fast::speed}} recovery time.

The curve shows the threshold (dimmest visible light) dropping over time: the first dip is the cones, then the rod–cone break at ~7–10 min, then the slower and deeper dip from the rods.Source: Dgtdsgn, , CC BY-SA 3.0

Generalizing to a population: {{c1::Inferring the results from a sample and applying it to a population}}
extra: Requires a random sample that is representative of the population

text: Regression to the mean: {{c1::if first measure is extreme, second measure will be closer to the mean}}
Face validity: {{c1::whether a layperson would say the test appears valid}}
Construct validity: whether the test measures {{c1::the construct it is supposed to measure}}

Compares the mean of a dependent variable between 2 groups (2 levels of one independent variable):
{{c1::T-test}}
Self-reported information is always vulnerable to {{c1::subjective bias}}
extra: Example: "Yeah, I was benching 400 lbs when I was 16"

text: A longitudinal study gathers data from the {{c1::same subjects repeatedly over a period of time}}
extra: Follows variables over a long period of time to look for correlation

text: Experimental study: {{c1::involves manipulation of variables}}
{{c1::External validity}}: whether results can be generalized to other situations or to other people (e.g., from a small study to a larger population)
extra: Subtypes: population validity and ecological validity

text: Operationalization: {{c1::Process of strictly defining variables into measurable factors}}
extra:
Taking a vague term and figuring out a way to measure it
Example: counting how often a child pushes others as a measure of aggression

text: {{c1::Reconstructive bias::Bias}}: poor recollection (especially relevant in retrospective studies)
Inter-rater reliability: {{c1::Consistent when two different people measure the same thing}}
Participant observation: {{c1::Observer participates in ongoing activities and records observations}}
extra: Observer is a "player" in the action

text: Confounding variable: {{c1::Changes in dependent variable may be due to existence of or variations in a third variable}}
extra: The third variable could provide an alternative explanation for the relationship between the variables

text:
Degree of dependence between 1 variable and another:
{{c1::Linear regression}}
{{c1::Inter-rater reliability}}: the degree to which two different researchers or raters agree in their assessments
Attrition bias: {{c1::Occurs when participants drop out of a long-term experiment or study}}
Predictive validity: how well the test can {{c1::predict}} future outcomes
Each participant is exposed to every level of the independent variable (repeated-measures design): {{c1::Within-subjects design}}
extra: Higher power: the same person serves in multiple conditions, which ↓ the individual-difference effects seen in between-subjects designs

text: {{c1::Bias}}: failure to be objective
ANOVA: {{c1::similar to t-test, but for 3+ groups}}

Null hypothesis vs. Alternative hypothesis is considered under:
{{c1::Hypothesis testing (any test: t-test, ANOVA, chi-square, etc.)}}
extra: H<sub>0</sub> = no difference/no relationship; H<sub>a</sub> = there is one. Every hypothesis test sets them up the same way: if p < α (usually 0.05), reject H<sub>0</sub>. Chi-square is just one such test (for categorical data); t-tests compare means of 2 groups and ANOVA compares 3+.

text: +/- 2 SD = {{c1::95%}} of the sample

Randomized controlled trial: {{c1::participants are randomly assigned to the treatment under study or a control
Tests efficacy and side effects}}
extra: Gold standard for a clinical trial

text: A confounding variable correlates with and explains {{c1::BOTH the IV & DV}}
extra: Example: nice roads and clean sidewalks seem related, but a wealthy neighborhood (the confounding variable) explains both

text: Study conducted over a long period of time, usually following a specific cohort of people: {{c1::Longitudinal study}}
extra: Example: tracking heart disease incidence over time while monitoring diet and smoking habits
